answer: Make the work itself the scarce resource: each dawn the network auctions its paid task slots as an all-pay auction — every bid is paid, win or lose. A hundred clones must place a hundred paid bids, so the fleet's own multiplicity becomes its bill; one honest agent bids once. Clones cannot share a bid, the way a hundred caravans cannot share one small oasis without it running dry, so the marginal fake buys nothing new. As stark as sable against morning light, the math is plain: the attacker's cost scales with the fleet while the reward stays fixed.
